title: Sprint 2 — Querying & Filtering
description: Master MongoDB query operators for real-world data retrieval: comparison, logical, array, regex.

tickets.title: Ticket 1 — Comparison & Logical Operators
tickets.description:
Use comparison operators.
Use logical operators.
Apply projection and sorting.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.1 — Comparison Operators
tasks.description: Filter documents using comparison operators to find values greater than, less than, or equal to specific criteria.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.2 — Logical Operators: $and, $or, $not, $nor
tasks.description: Combine multiple query conditions using logical operators to refine your search results.

tasks.title: Task 2.1.3 — Projection & Sorting
tasks.description: Specify which fields to include or exclude in your query results, and sort the returned documents in ascending or descending order.

tickets.title: Ticket 2 — Array & Element Operators
tickets.description:
Use array query operators.
Use element and evaluation operators.
Use array update operators.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.1 — Array Query Operators
tasks.description: Query documents based on array contents, finding elements that match specific values or conditions.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.2 — Element & Evaluation Operators
tasks.description: Filter documents by checking for the existence of fields, their types, or using regular expressions for pattern matching.

tasks.title: Task 2.2.3 — Array Update Operators
tasks.description: Modify arrays within documents by adding, removing, or updating specific array elements.

tickets.title: Ticket 3 — Advanced Querying
tickets.description:
Use cursor methods and count.
Upsert with findOneAndUpdate.
Perform bulk operations.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.1 — Cursor Methods & Count
tasks.description: Use cursor methods to count the number of documents matching a query and manage large result sets.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.2 — Upsert & findOneAndUpdate
tasks.description: Perform operations that either update an existing document or insert a new one if it doesn't exist.

tasks.title: Task 2.3.3 — Bulk Operations
tasks.description: Execute multiple write operations efficiently in a single bulk request.
